info.title: Overwatch AML Platform
info.description: Unified TradFi and Web3 Fund Flow Analysis Engine

post.description:
Authenticate the user and return an access token. Also sets the
httpOnly session cookie so the browser client authenticates without
touching the token in JavaScript.

Provisions a user in Keycloak and maps them to the local `app_users` table 
and hooks them into the executing `tenant`.

get.description: Get all users mapped to the current tenant.
Fetch predefined roles that an admin can assign to a user.

post.description: Map a role to a user internally.

get.description:
Monitoring feed with server-side filters (TASK-012): optional
minimum amount and transaction-type filters execute in SQL, never in
the client. Responses carry short-lived Cache-Control headers.

Alert list (currently over core.transactions until the alert table
exists) with server-side filters (TASK-012).
Explore the Apache AGE graph around a target entity.

Historical KPI trend (TASK-016): last N days from the daily KPI mart
for 30/60/90-day charts (N must be a multiple the UI can bucket).
CSV export of the daily KPI mart (TASK-016).
Generate KPIs and Case Management metrics for the Department Head dashboard.
Retrieve the latest Daily AML KPIs from the datamart for the Governance MIS dashboard.
Retrieve all STRs for the current tenant.

schema.title: Response List Strs Api V1 Str  Get

get.description: Retrieve a specific STR by its ID.

put.description: Update fields of a draft STR.

post.description: Move a draft STR into review (draft -> under_review).
Withdraw an STR that is not yet filed.

get.description: Version history index for an STR (append-only audit of every change).
Fetch one snapshot from the STR version history.

Export the STR as a PDF. The content SHA-256 (integrity anchor for
digital signing) is returned in the X-Content-Sha256 header.

post.description:
Finalize and submit the STR to JFIU. Mandatory fields are validated and
the filing transition is enforced (draft/under_review -> filed).

get.description: Export audit events as NDJSON for SIEM ingestion (one JSON object per line).
Recompute the audit hash chain and report whether it is intact.
Issue a single-use, TTL-bounded challenge for address-control proofs.

post.description: Verify a KYC/KYB credential and record it against a party (idempotent).
Maker step: register a wallet authorization (lands UNAUTHORIZED).

get.description: List wallet authorizations (masked at the API layer per TASK-041).

post.description:
Checker step: activate the authorization. Must be a different user
from the maker (maker-checker, TASK-040).
Deactivate an authorization (revocation kills the risk signal).

get.description:
Customer-360 verified-identity panel (AWI TASK-053): the party's
credentials (issuer, vct, status, validity window) and wallet
authorizations (custody, proof, authorized-until). Claims render masked
per the caller's role; raw-claim visibility is SENIOR_INVESTIGATOR+ and
is audited via the standard PII_UNMASKED trail.
Prometheus text-format metrics (TASK-022).

post.description:
Add a note to a case. Attachment content upload is deferred to the
object-store layer (file writes are literal-path confined); metadata
may be supplied now.

get.description:
Visual timeline of case activity (TASK-015): workflow events plus
audit actions for the case, newest first.

post.description: Bulk status update over a list of case ids (TASK-015).

get.description:
TASK-017: surface workflow instances stuck mid-flight (started but
never completed/failed) so operators can intervene.
Liveness/readiness probe: reports DB pool status (TASK-008).
